primaryText: Er will jemandem schmeicheln, aber sie wissen nicht, wem.
translation: He wants to flatter someone, but they don't know who.

alternatives.form: Er will jemandem schmeicheln, aber sie wissen nicht, wen.

comment: Chapter 2, §2.1.3, p. 42: Ross's (1969: 253) illustration, credited to George Williams, that the sluiced wh-phrase must agree in case with its correlate; schmeicheln 'flatter' assigns dative to its object. Expands the printed {wem /*wen} to the dative wem; the starred accusative wen is the alternative.
